SELECT TO_CHAR(A.BID) AS BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, A.STATUS, A.SUBJECT, A.REG_USER_ID, A.REG_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REG_DATE, A.REG_TIME, TO_CHAR(A.LCOUNT) AS LCOUNT, CASE WHEN A.EXPOSE_TARGET = 'CMN' THEN '전체' WHEN A.EXPOSE_TARGET = 'BUY' THEN CASE WHEN A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '전체' ELSE TO_CHAR((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE)) END WHEN A.EXPOSE_TARGET = 'SEL' THEN CASE WHEN A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '전체' ELSE TO_CHAR((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PO.AGENT) FROM ICOMPOHD PO WHERE PO.BUYER IN (SELECT DT.COM_CODE FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE) AND PO.PO_CREATE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') AND PO.STATUS <> 'D')) END ELSE '전체' END AS EXPOSE_CNT, A.OPEN_FLAG, DECODE(A.OPEN_FLAG, 'Y', '완료', 'E', '완료', 'N', '대기', '대기') AS OPEN_FLAG_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS TO_DATE, CASE WHEN A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '상시' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') END AS POST_PERIOD, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, DECODE(A.EXPOSE_TARGET, 'ALL', '전체', 'CMN', '공통', 'BUY', '고객사', 'SEL', '협력사', '전체') AS EXPOSE_TARGET_NM, A.NOTICE_TYPE, DECODE(A.NOTICE_TYPE, 'CMN', '공통', 'CST', '고객사별', 'CUS', '고객사별', '공통') AS NOTICE_TYPE_NM, A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE) AS TARGET_CUSTOMER_CNT, CASE WHEN A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '전체' ELSE TO_CHAR((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE)) END AS TARGET_CUSTOMER_NM, CASE WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'E' THEN 'END' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'ING' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND SYSDATE > TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'END' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND SYSDATE >= TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SYSDATE <= TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'ING' ELSE 'SCH' END AS PUBLISHING_STATUS, CASE WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'E' THEN '종료' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '게시중' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND SYSDATE > TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN '종료' WHEN A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND SYSDATE >= TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SYSDATE <= TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN '게시중' ELSE '예정' END AS PUBLISHING_STATUS_NM FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.STATUS = 'C' AND A.BTYPE = #{BTYPE}
AND TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{startDate},'/',''),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{endDate},'/',''),'YYYYMMDD')
AND ( A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR ( A.FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.FROM_DATE != ' ' AND TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{endDate},'/',''),'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{startDate},'/',''),'YYYYMMDD') ) )
AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET = #{exposeTarget}
AND A.NOTICE_TYPE IN ('CST', 'CUS')
AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = #{noticeType}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND DT.COM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{targetCustomer} || '%' )
AND (A.OPEN_FLAG = 'N' OR (A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG != 'Y' AND SYSDATE < TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')))
AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (SYSDATE >= TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SYSDATE <= TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')))
AND (A.OPEN_FLAG = 'E' OR (A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG != 'Y' AND SYSDATE > TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')))
AND A.OPEN_FLAG IN ('Y', 'E')
AND A.OPEN_FLAG = #{approvalStatus}
AND A.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{titleSearch} || '%'
AND A.REG_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{regUser} || '%'
AND A.IMPORTANT_FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.OPEN_FLAG = #{st_open_flag}
AND A.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{searchSubject} || '%'
AND A.REG_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchRegUser} || '%'
ORDER BY A.IMPORTANT_FLAG DESC, A.REG_DATE DESC, A.REG_TIME DESC, A.BID DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(A.BID) AS BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, A.STATUS, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTEXT AS CONTEXT, A.REG_USER_ID, A.REG_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REG_DATE, A.REG_TIME, A.REG_DEP, A.REG_DEP_NAME, A.IMAGE_KEY, TO_CHAR(A.LCOUNT) AS LCOUNT, A.OPEN_FLAG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS TO_DATE, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, A.NOTICE_TYPE, A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.BID = #{BID} AND A.BTYPE = #{BTYPE}

SELECT TO_CHAR(A.BID) AS BID, A.BTYPE, A.COM_CODE, A.COM_NAME, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_USER_ID, B.IRS_NO, B.CEO_NAME_LOC AS CEO_NAME FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY B ON A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE WHERE A.BID = #{BID} AND A.BTYPE = #{BTYPE} ORDER BY A.COM_CODE
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(BID), 0) + 1 AS BID FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE WHERE BTYPE = #{BTYPE}
INSERT INTO ICOMBOARD_NOTICE ( BID, BTYPE, COMPANY, STATUS, SUBJECT, CONTEXT, REG_USER_ID, REG_USER_NAME, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, REG_DEP, REG_DEP_NAME, IMAGE_KEY, LCOUNT, OPEN_FLAG, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, IMPORTANT_FLAG, ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, EXPOSE_TARGET, NOTICE_TYPE, ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{BID}, #{BTYPE}, #{COMPANY}, 'C', #{SUBJECT}, #{CONTEXT}, #{REG_USER_ID}, #{REG_USER_NAME}, #{REG_DATE}, #{REG_TIME}, #{REG_DEP}, #{REG_DEP_NAME}, #{IMAGE_KEY}, 0, 'N', REPLACE(#{FROM_DATE}, '/', ''), REPLACE(#{TO_DATE}, '/', ''), NVL(#{IMPORTANT_FLAG}, 'N'), NVL(#{ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG}, 'N'), NVL(#{EXPOSE_TARGET}, 'ALL'), NVL(#{NOTICE_TYPE}, 'CMN'), NVL(#{ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG}, 'N') )

INSERT INTO ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT ( BID, BTYPE, COMPANY, STATUS, COM_CODE, COM_NAME, REG_DATE, REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{BID}, #{BTYPE}, #{COMPANY}, 'C', #{COM_CODE}, #{COM_NAME}, #{REG_DATE}, #{REG_USER_ID} )
